title: Joining journey sentences
summary: Use the English meaning and Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase.

s01.sentenceGloss: We buy tickets and go to the train.

s02.sentenceGloss: Do you want to travel by bus or train?

s03.sentenceGloss: The journey is long, but it is not expensive.

s04.sentenceGloss: The train left early, so we got up at five.

s05.sentenceGloss: We took a taxi because the bus did not come.
s05.note: Eftersom introduces a reason; inte precedes kom.

s07.sentenceGloss: If the train is late, we wait at the station.
s07.note: The initial om clause is followed by the main-clause verb väntar.

s08.sentenceGloss: She says that the car is not broken.
